title: Add destination_v12: the speed curriculum with half the walks at the top speed and a back-off
summary: On the surrogate, destination_v11 (a quarter of the walks at the top speed) held the 0.05 m/s walks within about a millimetre of the ghost but left the 0.1 m/s destination pay flat near 0.72 for 4000 updates. destination_v12 returns to v10's half of the walks at the top speed and keeps v11's back-off below 0.65.
next: Train destination_v12 from the v9 checkpoint on the surrogate and test it against v9 at 0.05 to 0.15 m/s.
reason: A named experiment that no gate or registry entry uses yet; the canonical task and reward are unchanged.
